concept: A stack spaces items inside a pane with gaps from the scale, always smaller than the pane padding around them.

root.why: one flex container; direction, gap and alignment are the only decisions it makes

column.why: vertical by default, the order content is read in

row.why: horizontal for actions and metadata that belong on one line

g-xs.why: the smallest gap for a label and its value, which belong together

g-sm.why: a small gap for icon and text pairs

g-md.why: the default gap between items of one group

g-lg.why: a larger gap between groups inside a pane

g-xl.why: the largest gap inside a pane, still below the pane padding so the edge reads as the boundary

a-start.why: align to the start edge, where reading begins in every supported writing direction

a-center.why: centre items of different heights on one line, such as an avatar and a name

a-end.why: align to the end edge for trailing actions, which come last in reading order

a-stretch.why: stretch items to equal height when they are equal panes
